steps.title: Steam the cabbage
steps.body: Steam for about 10 minutes: **1 head red cabbage**, shredded finely, and **2 apples**, cut in slices.

steps.title: Cook the bacon and onion
steps.body: In another pan, cook until golden brown: **1 onion**, chopped, and **5 slices bacon**, chopped.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Mix cabbage/apple and bacon/onion mixture with: **¼ tsp cloves**, **2 Tbsp cider vinegar**, **2 tsp sugar**, **2 tsp salt** and **¾ tsp pepper**.
